Now, on to choosing what to get. You're going to need:

  • CPU
  • Motherboard
  • Memory
  • Storage
  • Power Supply
  • GPU
  • Case
  • Possibly an optical (CD) drive if you're not going to install through USB

The big things to look for in terms of compatibility are:

  • Is the CPU for the same socket as the motherboard?
  • Does the motherboard support my memory timings?
  • Does my power supply have enough wattage for my GPU?

From there it's really all up to you. I would recommend sticking with DDR3 for memory, DDR4 is still quite expensive yet. Go for an SSD boot drive if you can, the different in perceived speed is huge.
